codeReview.summary: The implementation successfully creates a shared module list that prevents divergence between flake.nix and colmena.nix. Both files now import from common-modules-list.nix, ensuring they stay in sync. The missing nixpkgs-xr module has been properly added to colmena.nix, fixing the divergence.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker correctly uses relative paths in the common-modules-list.nix file (./modules/default.nix) which works properly when imported from both flake.nix and colmena.nix. This follows Nix path resolution conventions where paths are relative to the importing file's location.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: common-modules-list.nix line 47: './modules/default.nix' - resolves correctly when imported from /etc/nixos/flake.nix and /etc/nixos/colmena.nix

sharedStateObservations.observation: The nixos-config-worker skill procedures align with the worker's approach. The worker encountered a path resolution issue when first moving the file to modules/ directory but correctly resolved it by moving to the root directory and updating import paths. This shows the skill's procedures are realistic but could benefit from clearer guidance on Nix path resolution in import contexts.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows worker moved file from modules/ to root directory due to path resolution issues, then successfully updated imports in both flake.nix and colmena.nix

sharedStateObservations.observation: No new services were started. The worker only used file system operations and Nix evaluation commands (nix flake check, nix build, colmena build) which are appropriate for this type of configuration refactoring.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Worker commands: nix flake check, nix build --dry-run, colmena build --all commands are all validation/build-only, no service activation

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker discovered that Nix flakes only include git-tracked files, requiring explicit git add before import can work. This is important knowledge for NixOS configuration that should be documented in the skill.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows: 'git add modules/common-modules-list.nix' after realizing the file wasn't being included in the flake evaluation

summary: The feature was successfully implemented. The worker created a shared common-modules-list.nix file that both flake.nix and colmena.nix now import, eliminating the divergence issue. All verification steps pass: both configurations build successfully, both files import from the shared source, and the divergence has been resolved.
